name: WPCasa Migration Tool
author: WPSight

sections.description:
This plugin migrates the data structure from the old WPCasa Framework to the new WPCasa Plugin with listings.
After completing the migration, you can safely remove both this plugin and the WPCasa Legacy plugin.

Please note that after the migration, URLs will change from domain.ltd/property/my-best-house to domain.ltd/listing/my-best-house. To prevent loss of search engine rankings or broken links, WPCasa automatically redirects /property/ to /listing/.

If the redirection does not work, ensure that all caching and redirection plugins are disabled. Additionally, reset the permalink structure by saving the settings again.

Contributor

Kudo to @sebastienserre, the original author of this fantastic plugin that helps many people get on with their fantastic WPCasa website.
sections.installation:
There’s no settings, just activate and it is.
If you habe successfully migrated properties in listings, you can delete this plugin
